title: IPMA fire risk
what: The daily fire risk class (RCM, low to maximum) for every municipality of mainland Portugal, today and the next two days.
publisher: IPMA, Instituto Português do Mar e da Atmosfera

schedule.how: the Pages workflow (.github/workflows/pages.yml), on a schedule at 17 minutes past each hour, and on every push to dev

terms.summary: IPMA: free to copy and use for personal or public use if the use has no profit-making or offensive purpose; always name IPMA as the source.
terms.quote: O Utilizador pode copiar, importar ou utilizar gratuitamente informações ou símbolos nacionais existentes neste site para uso pessoal ou público desde que dessa utilização não decorram finalidades lucrativas ou ofensivas. O Utilizador deve referir, sempre, a fonte de informação.
terms.republish: with conditions: attribution to IPMA; no profit-making purpose
terms.open_question: Whether a paid reading meter on a PrompTugal site counts as a profit-making purpose under these terms is for Dinis to decide (or to ask IPMA). Until then the data site itself carries no meter.

vault.name: promptugal-data-ipma-fire-risk
vault.layout: latest/<file> (the bytes as received, overwritten each run), <yyyy>/<mm>/<dd>/<hh>/<file>-<hhmmss>.json (a dated copy only when the bytes changed), latest/reads.json
vault.note: Public read key: the source is public, so anyone may read the vault. A read key is derived one way and cannot write. The write key is never in this repository.

code: the collector reads the source and writes latest.json, reads.json and the vault copy
GitHub Actions runs it every hour and deploys the site
the build makes the API, the OpenAPI description and the pages
agents: data@PrompTugal.dinis (Opus) wrote the collector, this card and the pages on 17 November 2026; data.dev@ and data.design@ (Sonnet) wrote parts of the site build and the design variations
people: Dinis Cruz instructs; no person has checked the values yet (not reviewed)

cost.runner: GitHub Actions on a public repository: no charge (GitHub's terms for public repositories); about 3 minutes a run for all sources together (measured locally, 17 November 2026)
cost.build_tokens: not measured: accountant@'s ledger is not running on this account; to be added when it is
cost.note: Code only: no model is called when the data is collected.
